description.en: A small scapular elevation while two light dumbbells are held overhead.
description.tr: İki hafif dambıl baş üstünde tutulurken yapılan küçük kürek kemiği yükseltmesi.

en: Stand stable with two light dumbbells held overhead and elbows straight but not forced.
Raise the shoulder blades slightly toward the ears without bending the elbows or arching the back.
Lower the shoulder blades under control; use a load you can keep stable overhead.
tr: İki hafif dambılı baş üstünde tutup dengeli dur; dirseklerini zorlayarak kilitleme.
Dirseklerini bükmeden veya belini kavislendirmeden kürek kemiklerini hafifçe yukarı yükselt.
Kontrollü indir; baş üstünde dengede tutabildiğin ağırlığı kullan.

source.title: Open Exercise Atlas illustrated muscle coverage

alt.en: Two grayscale panels show the start and finish of Overhead Dumbbell Shrug, with the target muscle highlighted in red.
